tasks.label: Java Run (package-aware input/output)
args: $source = '${file}'; $sourceDir = Split-Path -Parent $source; $match = Select-String -Path $source -Pattern '^\s*package\s+([A-Za-z_][\w.]*)\s*;' | Select-Object -First 1; $package = if ($match) { $match.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value } else { '' }; $className = if ($package) { "$package.${fileBasenameNoExtension}" } else { '${fileBasenameNoExtension}' }; javac -d "${workspaceFolder}\bin" "$source"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { if (Test-Path "$sourceDir\input.txt") { Get-Content "$sourceDir\input.txt" -Raw | java -cp "${workspaceFolder}\bin" $className | Out-File -Encoding utf8 "$sourceDir\output.txt" } else { java -cp "${workspaceFolder}\bin" $className } }
